# Inert wire mapping for the source-only typing authority

Protocol is `oxid-array-source-typing-observation-v1`. Every JSONL line is one object with a `row` discriminator. Order is header, loader/selector/provenance phase markers and sources/AST inventory, resolution attempt, complete resolved inventories, type attempt and complete typed inventories or diagnostics, reservations, summary, complete. Compiler errors can end at earlier phases. JSON names below are the exact adapter spellings.

- Origins: `[file,start,end]` half-open original UTF-8 byte positions. Every emitted semantic span is checked in the formatting pass against the original map. Compare to authority `{file,start,end,...}` and independently reconstruct text/locations using the bound source row. `source` has file/identity/role/path/original_path/bytes/text. The external envelope computes SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 `text` and binds it to manifest path/role/file. No expected hash enters compiler code.
- `header`: case/scope, selected base and core_manifest_sha256, private-owned-test-seam path, immutable ObserveArrayTypes admission, effective row/byte/retained/scratch/work limits, semantic_metric=json-values-and-keys, work_observation_enabled=false. Exact source/adapter closure and binary/profile digests reside in the external run receipt, avoiding self-referential source hashes.
- `phase`: phase/status. Marker statuses attempted/completed/failed/not-attempted/not-completed distinguish actual driver stages. Lex/parse markers include attempted_files/completed_files from four fixed passive loader counters, including loader failures. A successful resolve also certifies successful index construction; a private bounded current-phase accessor identifies index completion on a resolution error. No type attempt follows resolve failure. Typed rows exist only after the complete successful typeck owner returns.
- `selector`: module/file/owned. `ast_inventory`: ast_expression_count/E_ast/target_wrappers/owned/modules. Per-module syntax selector inventories are passive observer scans; the actual whole-project SourceOwner selector runs once on the compiler meter. Independent AST counts scan actual retained vectors.
- `record`: id/declaration/origin/end/fields. `field`: record/id/declaration/origin/scalar. `signature`: function/module/local/declaration/origin/result/parameters. `parameter`: function/position/type. `function`: id/body/end/bindings/expressions/blocks. Counts come from full actual vectors and must exactly match row coverage, without gaps/duplicates.
- `binding`: function/id/origin/annotation/mutable/scope/parameter_position. `block`: function/id/origin/end/statements. `statement`: function/block/position/origin/kind plus exact roots and retained fields. Let has binding/init/roots; Return value/roots; Assign binding/target_origin/operator_origin/value/roots; IndexAssign base/base_origin/target_origin/operator_origin/value/index/roots=[value,index]; FieldAssign additionally field_origin; loop/branch rows retain condition and block/loop IDs. Statement position preserves each actual block vector.
- `expression`: function/id/origin/kind plus fields. Bool/I32 have value; Unit no extra; Binding has binding; Group child; ArrayLiteral elements; IndexRead base/base_origin/index; ArrayLength base/base_origin; FieldRead base/base_origin/field_origin; Not operand/operator_origin; binary nodes operator/left/right/operator_origin. Call has target/declaration/arguments: value arguments have expression; borrow arguments permission/binding/forwarded/origin/name_origin/star_origin. StructLiteral has record and ordered fields of record/field/value/origin. IDs are actual append order, never span order.
- `typed_expression`: function/id/type/projection. `typed_binding`: function/id/type. `typed_block`: function/id/flow containing the unchanged FlowSummary Debug spelling. `typed_statement`: function/block/position/projection. All successful vectors are copied in full. These inventories are post-hoc, with no runtime-order claim.
- Value type spelling is exactly the frozen authority's scalar `{tag:scalar,scalar:bool|i32|unit}`, fixed_array `{tag:fixed_array,element,length}`, and record `{tag:record,record_id,declaration}`. Parameter type is `{tag:value,value}` or `{tag:reference,kind:shared|exclusive,aggregate}`. Projection is null or binding/mode/record/field. An absent binding annotation is null.
- `reservation`: allocator attempt ordinal, kind/length/element_bytes/success/cumulative_hir_entries. Parser and HIR kinds remain distinct. All HIR events appear in actual allocator order, including zero and failed requests. No capacity claim is made.
- `diagnostic`: exact human/json_line bytes as strings and parsed diagnostic object. The JSON line includes one final newline; `diagnostic` matches parsing that string. Ordered diagnostics/secondary/notes are preserved. Original map validates spans before fixture-relative map rendering.
- `summary`: entry, actual hir_expression_count/E_hir/ast_expression_count/E_ast/target_wrappers/work/allocator_attempts/trace_rows/trace_row_bytes/work_observation_rows/resolved_executable/typed_executable/functions/signatures/records; earlier resolution failures instead contain work/work_phase/allocator_attempts. `complete`: complete=true, outcome typed-success or diagnostic-complete, rows_before_footer/bytes_before_footer/semantic_units_before_footer/category_counts/diagnostics/auxiliary_requested_bytes/auxiliary_peak_requested_bytes/diagnostic_render_bound_bytes/descriptor_overlap_bound_bytes.

The semantic-entry metric deliberately overcounts: each JSON value and object key is one unit, including object/array containers, every nested span scalar, child ID, argument, field, and type field. A stateful streaming counter counts before output reservation; quoted punctuation is ignored. Both top-level lines and semantic units are independently exported. Footer admission also consumes the limit. Category counts cover all preceding rows; typed_statement is grouped under typed_block in this version and the comparator must count both. Complete itself is separately present exactly once and last.

Missing/duplicate rows, invalid references/origins/types, unknown row/kind/tag, count mismatch, incomplete phases, diagnostic/typed overlap, changed limits/roster/source identity, extra files or absent completion fail closed. Only source predicates explicitly frozen in the admitted authority support semantic qualification; other fields are passive completeness inventory. Guard/failure-injection/small work tests are separate producer controls and do not run through this normal observer.
